retrievalProfile.description: A surreal vertical inversion featuring a portrait descending from the top edge against a bright sky background with bold, centered bottom typography.
triggerTerms: bold white sans serif bottom text

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, upside-down portrait of a person wearing bright red, appearing to hang from the top of the frame against a vibrant blue sky with wispy clouds, anchored by large, clean white sans-serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical inversion of the subject creates a surreal gravity effect
High contrast between the primary red clothing and the cyan sky
Clean white typography acts as a heavy visual base for the floating subject
Soft lighting on the face contrasts with the sharp, geometric letterforms
coreInvariants: Subject entering from the top frame edge
Bold white sans-serif text at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the top two-thirds of the frame in an inverted position.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white typography at the bottom provides a stable foundation for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the inverted face at the top, follows the vertical axis down to the bold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue sky provides ample breathing room around the head and between the subject and the text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary colors (red and blue) with high value in the white elements.

composition.relationshipToImage: overlaying the bottom of the sky background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold weight for maximum impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold nature of the display text.
Provides the clean, condensed, uppercase aesthetic required.
Offers a similar condensed geometric structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person wearing a bright red jacket, positioned upside down so their head enters from the top of the frame. The background should be a clear blue sky with soft, wispy white clouds. The lighting should be bright and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, condensed uppercase sans-serif text centered at the bottom of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the text bold, white, and sans-serif?
Is the background a vibrant blue sky?
Is the text centered at the bottom?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Joe'
Do not replicate specific facial features of the original person
Do not copy specific clothing brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Check that the head is not cut off awkwardly at the top
Ensure the red of the jacket is highly saturated
Verify the text is perfectly centered
Confirm the sky looks natural despite the inverted subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Inverted Portrait + Sky Backdrop + Bottom-Weighted Bold Sans-Serif
